notes.title: Some bugfixes and Steam Deck compatibility added
notes.content:
Since people seem to still buy this during sales, I made a little update.
[list]
[*]runs now on Linux and Steam Deck
[*]comes now with an OpenJRE runtime, no separate Java runtime needed
[*]fixed some bugs with wrong buttons/axis on some controllers
[*]enhanced menus to be fully controllable without a keyboard
[/list]
